strict_tau5.description: Certificate transmission must complete within the five-message cycle; incomplete transport at the cycle boundary produces Timeout and resets the service entry state.

extended_reassembly.description: Certificate fragmentation may continue across nominal cycles while the same queue/loss bounds remain in force.

verification_semantics.eligible_valid_message: Primary conditional profile: the pending candidate is assumed to pass the declared protocol-eligibility checks once verification completes.
verification_semantics.general_verify_outcome: Stress profile: verification completion may produce either Eligible or Rejected; rejection retains old authenticated information and resets service entry.
